name: Inochi Creator
blurb: Inochi2D is a framework for realtime 2D puppet animation which can be used for VTubing, game development and digital animation.
description:
Inochi2D is a framework for realtime 2D puppet animation which can be used for VTubing,
game development and digital animation.

Inochi Creator is a tool that lets you create and edit Inochi2D puppets.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
